cycle.claim_boundary: This finite audit covers the sealed 17x17 zero-mean-forced fixed-leaf quadratic chart, 72 independent initial reduced coordinates, 64 reduced steps and eight one-step-defect checkpoints in binary64. It does not regrade Q011f or Q011f1 shadowing, propagate a full LBM orbit for 64 steps, establish all-time equivalence, a uniform remainder, higher-order coefficients, other grids, forces or walls, D3Q27, SSM existence or uniqueness, normal attraction or a basin. Q011g remains rejected and TT-cross remains unauthorized.
